name: Identity Fusion NG
description: Identity Fusion NG is a connector that allows you to manage Identity Fusion accounts by mapping account attributes from multiple sources, defining new attributes and unique identifiers, and matching accounts with existing identities to prevent duplicates.

items.sectionHelpMessage: Configure how this connector connects to Identity Security Cloud. See [Connection Settings](configuration/connection.md).

items.label: Identity Security Cloud API URL
items.helpKey: Base URL of your Identity Security Cloud tenant (format: https:// .api.identitynow.com). See [Identity Security Cloud API URL](configuration/connection.md#baseurl).

items.label: Personal Access Token ID
items.helpKey: Enter the Client ID from your Personal Access Token. See [Personal Access Token ID](configuration/connection.md#clientid).

items.label: Personal Access Token secret
items.helpKey: Enter the Client Secret from your Personal Access Token. See [Personal Access Token secret](configuration/connection.md#clientsecret).

items.sectionHelpMessage: Define which identities are in scope. See [Configuring sources and scope](../use-guides/configuration/configuring-sources-and-scope.md).

items.label: Include identities in the scope?
items.helpKey: When enabled, existing identities are included alongside accounts from your configured sources. See [Include identities in the scope?](configuration/source.md#includeidentities).

items.label: Identity Scope Query
items.helpKey: Filter which identities are included using a search query. See [Identity Scope Query](configuration/source.md#identityscopequery).

items.sectionHelpMessage: Select and configure authoritative account sources. See [Configuring sources and scope](../use-guides/configuration/configuring-sources-and-scope.md).

items.label: Source name
items.helpKey: Enter the exact name of the source as it appears in Identity Security Cloud (case-sensitive). See [Source name](configuration/source.md#name).

items.label: Enabled
items.helpKey: Turn off to temporarily exclude this source from processing without removing it. See [Enabled](configuration/source.md#enabled).

items.label: Source type
items.helpKey: Choose how accounts from this source are handled. See [Source type](configuration/source.md#sourcetype).

items.label: Disable non-matching accounts
items.helpKey: Automatically disable orphan accounts that no longer match any identity after aggregation. See [Disable non-matching accounts](configuration/source.md#disablenonmatchingaccounts).

items.label: Deferred candidate matching
items.helpKey: Deferred candidate matching: after identity scoring, also compare this account to other provisional Fusion accounts from. See [Deferred candidate matching](configuration/source.md#deferredmatching).

items.label: Include record accounts in Match
items.helpKey: Enable when record accounts should be matched against Fusion identities. See [Include record accounts in Match](configuration/source.md#includerecordaccountsformatching).

items.label: Accounts API filter
items.helpKey: Server-side ISC account filter sent to the Accounts API (filters parameter). See [Accounts API filter](configuration/source.md#accountfilter).

items.label: Accounts JMESPath filter
items.helpKey: Client-side JMESPath expression applied after accounts are fetched (page-wise as { accounts: [...] }). See [Accounts JMESPath filter](configuration/source.md#accountjmespathfilter).

items.label: Aggregation batch size
items.helpKey: Limit the number of accounts processed per run. See [Aggregation batch size](configuration/source.md#accountlimit).

items.label: Account aggregation mode
items.helpKey: Choose when to pull the latest accounts from this source. See [Account aggregation mode](configuration/source.md#aggregationmode).

items.label: Aggregation wait timeout (minutes)
items.helpKey: Maximum time to wait for this source's aggregation to finish when using Aggregate before processing. See [Aggregation wait timeout (minutes)](configuration/source.md#aggregationtimeout).

items.label: Aggregation delay (minutes)
items.helpKey: How many minutes to wait after processing completes before refreshing accounts from this source. See [Aggregation delay (minutes)](configuration/source.md#aggregationdelay).

items.label: Optimized aggregation
items.helpKey: Only process accounts that have changed since the last run, improving performance. See [Optimized aggregation](configuration/source.md#optimizedaggregation).

items.label: Optimized aggregation
items.helpKey: Only process accounts that have changed since the last run, improving performance. See [Optimized aggregation](configuration/source.md#optimizedaggregation).

items.label: Correlation mode
items.helpKey: Choose how uncorrelated source accounts are linked to identities. See [Correlation mode](configuration/source.md#correlationmode).

items.label: Correlation attribute display name
items.helpKey: Friendly display label for the reverse-correlation attribute shown in Identity Security Cloud. See [Correlation attribute display name](configuration/source.md#correlationdisplayname).

items.label: Correlation attribute name
items.helpKey: Internal name for the attribute used to link accounts via reverse correlation. See [Correlation attribute name](configuration/source.md#correlationattribute).

items.sectionHelpMessage: Control account maintenance and processing behavior. See [Source Settings](configuration/source.md).

items.label: Maximum history messages
items.helpKey: Number of processing history entries to keep per account. See [Maximum history messages](configuration/source.md#maxhistorymessages).

items.label: Delete accounts with no managed accounts left?
items.helpKey: Automatically remove a Fusion account when all of its linked source accounts have been deleted. See [Delete accounts with no managed accounts left?](configuration/source.md#deleteempty).

items.label: Skip accounts with missing ID?
items.helpKey: Skip accounts that are missing a unique identity value. See [Skip accounts with missing ID?](configuration/source.md#skipaccountswithmissingid).

items.label: Enable cascade aggregation for single account read
items.helpKey: Aggregate managed sources before single account read. See [Cascade aggregation](configuration/source.md#cascadeaggregationenabled).

items.sectionHelpMessage: Map and merge source attributes onto Fusion accounts. See [Mapping attributes](../use-guides/configuration/mapping-attributes.md).

items.label: Default attribute merge from multiple sources
items.helpKey: When multiple sources provide the same attribute, choose how to combine them. See [Default attribute merge from multiple sources](configuration/mapping.md#attributemerge).

items.label: New attribute
items.helpKey: Name for this attribute on the Fusion account. See [New attribute](configuration/mapping.md#newattribute).

items.label: Existing attributes
items.helpKey: Source attribute names to pull values from. See [Existing attributes](configuration/mapping.md#existingattributes).

items.label: Default attribute merge from multiple sources
items.helpKey: Override the default merge strategy for this specific attribute. See [Default attribute merge from multiple sources](configuration/mapping.md#attributemerge).

items.label: Source name
items.helpKey: Name of the source whose value should be used for this attribute when available. See [Source name](configuration/mapping.md#source).

items.sectionHelpMessage: Define dynamic computed attributes with Apache Velocity. See [Defining attributes](../use-guides/configuration/defining-attributes.md) and [Velocity context](../reference/velocity-context.md).

items.label: Normal Attribute Definitions
items.helpKey: Define attributes whose values are defined from templates using mapped account data. See [Normal Attribute Definitions](configuration/definition.md#normalattributedefinitions).

items.label: Attribute Name
items.helpKey: Name for this defined attribute on the Fusion account. See [Attribute Name](configuration/definition.md#name).

items.label: Apache Velocity expression
items.helpKey: Velocity template that defines the attribute value. See [Apache Velocity expression](configuration/definition.md#expression).

items.label: Static
items.helpKey: When enabled, the attribute is evaluated only when it has no value. See [Static](configuration/definition.md#static).

items.label: Refresh on each aggregation?
items.helpKey: When enabled, the value is recalculated on every aggregation. See [Refresh on each aggregation?](configuration/definition.md#refresh).

items.label: Case selection
items.helpKey: Convert the defined value to a specific letter case. See [Case selection](configuration/definition.md#case).

items.label: Normalize special characters?
items.helpKey: Replace accented and special characters with their plain equivalents (e.g. See [Normalize special characters?](configuration/definition.md#normalize).

items.label: Remove spaces?
items.helpKey: Remove all spaces from the defined value. See [Remove spaces?](configuration/definition.md#spaces).

items.label: Trim leading and trailing spaces?
items.helpKey: Remove extra spaces at the beginning and end of the defined value. See [Trim leading and trailing spaces?](configuration/definition.md#trim).

items.label: Maximum length
items.helpKey: Limit the defined value to this many characters. See [Maximum length](configuration/definition.md#maxlength).

items.label: Maximum attempts for unique definition
items.helpKey: Maximum number of tries to find a value that is not already taken. See [Maximum attempts for unique definition](configuration/definition.md#maxattempts).

items.label: Unique Attribute Definitions
items.helpKey: Define attributes that must have a unique value across all accounts, such as usernames or employee IDs. See [Unique Attribute Definitions](configuration/definition.md#uniqueattributedefinitions).

items.label: Attribute Name
items.helpKey: Name for this unique attribute on the Fusion account. See [Attribute Name](configuration/definition.md#name).

items.label: Apache Velocity expression
items.helpKey: Velocity template that defines the unique value (required). See [Apache Velocity expression](configuration/definition.md#expression).

items.label: Minimum counter digits ($counter)
items.helpKey: Minimum number of digits for the counter, padded with leading zeros. See [Minimum counter digits ($counter)](configuration/definition.md#digits).

items.label: Use incremental counter?
items.helpKey: Always assign the next number in sequence instead of only adding a number when there is a conflict. See [Use incremental counter?](configuration/definition.md#useincrementalcounter).

items.label: Counter start value
items.helpKey: The first number the counter will use. See [Counter start value](configuration/definition.md#counterstart).

items.label: Case selection
items.helpKey: Convert the defined value to a specific letter case. See [Case selection](configuration/definition.md#case).

items.label: Normalize special characters?
items.helpKey: Replace accented and special characters with their plain equivalents (e.g. See [Normalize special characters?](configuration/definition.md#normalize).

items.label: Remove spaces?
items.helpKey: Remove all spaces from the defined value. See [Remove spaces?](configuration/definition.md#spaces).

items.label: Trim leading and trailing spaces?
items.helpKey: Remove extra spaces at the beginning and end of the defined value. See [Trim leading and trailing spaces?](configuration/definition.md#trim).

items.label: Maximum length
items.helpKey: Limit the defined value to this many characters. See [Maximum length](configuration/definition.md#maxlength).

items.label: Manual review match score [0-100]
items.helpKey: Minimum weighted combined similarity (0-100) required for a potential match. See [Manual review match score [0-100]](configuration/matching.md#fusionmanualreviewscore).

items.label: Enable automatic merge
items.helpKey: When enabled, merge the managed account into the matched Fusion identity without a review form if the combined score mee. See [Enable automatic merge](configuration/matching.md#fusionenableautomerge).

items.label: Automatic merge match score [0-100]
items.helpKey: Matches with a combined score equal to or higher than this threshold will be automatically merged. See [Automatic merge match score [0-100]](configuration/matching.md#fusionautomergescore).

items.label: Attribute
items.helpKey: The identity attribute to compare when looking for matches (e.g. See [Attribute](configuration/matching.md#attribute).

items.label: Matching algorithm
items.helpKey: Algorithm used to compare values. See [Matching algorithm](configuration/matching.md#algorithm).

options.label: Enhanced Name Matcher
options.docLinkLabel: Strict matching that handles accents and normalization

options.label: Jaro-Winkler
options.docLinkLabel: Mechanical string comparison tolerant of typos

options.label: LIG3
options.docLinkLabel: Advanced hybrid handling missing gaps and character variations

options.label: Dice
options.docLinkLabel: N-gram model highly tolerant of word reordering

options.label: Double Metaphone
options.docLinkLabel: Evaluates strings based on their English pronunciation

items.label: Custom match score (Velocity)
items.helpKey: Apache Velocity template evaluated for each account/identity pair. See [Custom match score (Velocity)](configuration/matching.md#customvelocityexpression).

items.label: Similarity threshold & weight [0-100]
items.helpKey: One setting, two roles: (1) minimum similarity (0-100) the rule must meet to pass, and (2) blend weight in the combined . See [Similarity threshold & weight [0-100]](configuration/matching.md#fusionscore).

items.label: Mandatory match
items.helpKey: When enabled, this rule must meet its minimum similarity for a potential match. See [Mandatory match](configuration/matching.md#mandatory).

items.label: Skip match if missing
items.helpKey: When enabled (default), this rule is skipped if either value is missing (null, undefined, or empty after trimming). See [Skip match if missing](configuration/matching.md#skipmatchifmissing).

items.label: Skip match if threshold not met
items.helpKey: When enabled, this rule is excluded from the weighted combined match score if its computed similarity is below its minim. See [Skip match if threshold not met](configuration/matching.md#skipmatchifthresholdnotmet).

items.sectionHelpMessage: Configure manual review for potential matches. See [Review forms and reviewers](../use-guides/configuration/review-forms-and-reviewers.md).

items.label: List of Fusion account attributes to include in form
items.helpKey: Account attributes displayed on the review form to help reviewers compare potential matches. See [List of Fusion account attributes to include in form](configuration/matching.md#fusionformattributes).

items.label: Maximum candidates per review form
items.helpKey: Maximum number of potential identity matches shown on each manual review form. See [Maximum candidates per review form](configuration/matching.md#fusionmaxcandidatesforform).

items.label: Manual review expiration days
items.helpKey: Number of days a reviewer has to respond before the review form expires. See [Manual review expiration days](configuration/matching.md#fusionformexpirationdays).

items.label: Owners are global reviewers?
items.helpKey: Always add the source owner and any member of the source's assigned governance group as reviewers on every review form, . See [Owners are global reviewers?](configuration/matching.md#fusionownerisglobalreviewer).

items.label: Send report to owner on aggregation?
items.helpKey: Send a summary report to the source owner after each run, including potential matches, processing outcomes, and source-t. See [Send report to owner on aggregation?](configuration/matching.md#fusionreportonaggregation).

items.label: Enable localized user communications?
items.helpKey: Localize emails, aggregation reports, and Fusion review forms. See [Enable localized user communications?](configuration/matching.md#enablelocalization).

items.label: Default Language
items.helpKey: Leave unset for English. See [Default Language](configuration/matching.md#defaultlanguage).

items.label: Identity Language Attribute
items.helpKey: Identity attribute containing the reviewer's preferred language. See [Identity Language Attribute](configuration/matching.md#identitylanguageattribute).

items.label: Reset accounts?
items.helpKey: On the next aggregation only, clear all Fusion account data and emit zero accounts (rebuild from scratch on the followin. See [Reset accounts?](configuration/advanced.md#resetaccounts).

items.label: Reset forms?
items.helpKey: On the next aggregation only, delete all Fusion review form definitions. See [Reset forms?](configuration/advanced.md#resetforms).

items.label: Force attribute refresh on next aggregation?
items.helpKey: On the next aggregation only, recalculate all computed Normal-type attributes even if no changes were detected. See [Force attribute refresh on next aggregation?](configuration/advanced.md#forceattributerefresh).

items.label: Enable concurrency check?
items.helpKey: Safeguard against data conflicts if multiple aggregations overlap. See [Enable concurrency check?](configuration/advanced.md#concurrencycheckenabled).

items.label: Managed accounts batch size
items.helpKey: Number of uncorrelated managed accounts processed in each match detection batch. See [Managed accounts batch size](configuration/advanced.md#managedaccountsbatchsize).

items.label: Scoring concurrency limit
items.helpKey: Maximum concurrent identity-comparison scoring operations during managed-account analysis. See [Scoring concurrency limit](configuration/advanced.md#scoringmaxconcurrency).

items.sectionHelpMessage: Configure proxy, logging, and scenario recording. See [Proxy mode](../reference/proxy-mode.md).

items.label: Enable external processing?
items.helpKey: Gateway toggle for external infrastructure. See [Enable external processing?](configuration/advanced.md#externalprocessingenabled).

items.label: Server URL
items.helpKey: Shared external target — proxy endpoint when proxy mode is on, log HTTP endpoint when proxy mode is off. See [Server URL](configuration/advanced.md#externaltargeturl).

items.label: Password
items.helpKey: Shared secret for proxy authentication. See [Password](configuration/advanced.md#externaltargetpassword).

items.label: Enable proxy mode?
items.helpKey: Delegate operation processing to the external target. See [Enable proxy mode?](configuration/advanced.md#externalproxyenabled).

items.label: Enable chain recording?
items.helpKey: Record API call chains on the proxy server for replay testing. See [Enable chain recording?](configuration/advanced.md#externalrecordingenabled).

items.label: Recording chain name
items.helpKey: Name for the recording chain directory. See [Recording chain name](configuration/advanced.md#recordingname).

items.label: Enable external logging?
items.helpKey: Stream connector logs to external infrastructure. See [Enable external logging?](configuration/advanced.md#externalloggingenabled).

items.label: External logging level
items.helpKey: Minimum log level for external logging delivery. See [External logging level](configuration/advanced.md#externallogginglevel).

items.sectionHelpMessage: Fine-tune API limits and execution resilience. See [Tune API performance](../use-guides/operation/tune-api-performance.md).

items.label: Provisioning timeout (seconds)
items.helpKey: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for a provisioning operation to complete. See [Provisioning timeout (seconds)](configuration/advanced.md#provisioningtimeout).

items.label: Maximum concurrent requests
items.helpKey: How many HTTP requests can run at the same time. See [Maximum concurrent requests](configuration/advanced.md#maxconcurrentrequests).

items.label: Parallel pagination batch size
items.helpKey: Max in-flight parallel pages per pagination stream. See [Parallel pagination batch size](configuration/advanced.md#parallelbatchsize).

items.label: Requests per second
items.helpKey: Legacy rate hint: derives the sliding-window cap as requests per second × 10 seconds (max 100). See [Requests per second](configuration/advanced.md#requestspersecond).

items.label: API request retries
items.helpKey: How many times to retry a failed request before giving up. See [API request retries](configuration/advanced.md#maxretries).

items.label: Processing wait time (seconds)
items.helpKey: How often (in seconds) to send a progress signal during long operations to prevent timeouts. See [Processing wait time (seconds)](configuration/advanced.md#processingwait).

items.label: Heartbeat interval (seconds)
items.helpKey: How often (in seconds) the connector emits STATUS and EVENT_SUMMARY lines during long operations. See [Heartbeat interval (seconds)](configuration/advanced.md#heartbeatinterval).

items.label: Enable priority processing?
items.helpKey: Process critical operations (like saving data) before less urgent ones (like logging). See [Enable priority processing?](configuration/advanced.md#enablepriority).
